observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a black DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' lettering on the pentaprism hump, red grip accent typical of Nikon DSLRs.
A detachable lens is mounted, with 'VR' and partial 'Nikon' markings visible on the lens barrel in photo 1; focal length markings (18-55 range) are partially visible but blurred.
Both photos show a retail box with a yellow 'Nikon' logo and a 'VR' circular badge, consistent with a Nikon DX kit-lens box design.
Several areas of the body, box, and background items are blacked out/redacted, obscuring serial numbers, price tags, and some accessory boxes (e.g., flash, selfie stick).
A visible watermark 'PHOTOPLUG INTEGRATED' appears across both images, suggesting these are seller/stock-style photos rather than unique photos of the exact unit.
No model number (e.g., D3300, D3400, D5300, D5600) is legible anywhere on the body, lens, or box in either photo.
No shots of the LCD screen, battery, charger, memory card slot, or shutter count/menu screen are provided.

risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model badge on the body (front or top plate) or the rear LCD boot screen showing model name.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest-value model in that spec family

risks.risk: Actual working condition of sensor, shutter, and AF system is unverified; shutter count unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the shutter count from a diagnostic app or a short video of the camera powering on, focusing, and firing a test shot.

risks.risk: Photos may be generic/stock images from the seller's catalog (watermark 'PHOTOPLUG INTEGRATED') rather than the actual unit being sold, so true cosmetic condition and included accessories are unclear.
risks.proof: Fresh, unedited photos of the actual unit (body, lens, LCD, battery, charger, strap) with a handwritten date/name note for proof of current possession.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/worst-case cosmetic condition, accessories not included

risks.risk: Lens VR (vibration reduction) functionality and optical condition (fungus, scratches, zoom ring smoothness) cannot be assessed.
risks.proof: A photo through the lens against a light source showing clear glass, plus a short clip showing VR switch and zoom/focus ring operation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens non-functional/VR not working

risks.risk: Completeness of kit (battery, charger, strap, caps, manual) is unclear since box flap and surrounding items are blacked out.
risks.proof: An unobstructed photo of all included accessories laid out next to the body and box.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, no accessories

Shutter count screen or a power-on/test-shot video.
Unobstructed photo of all accessories included (battery, charger, strap, caps).
Through-the-lens photo to check for fungus/scratches and VR switch demonstration.
response.reason: The camera is a Nikon DX-series DSLR with a kit lens, but no legible model number is visible, and the stated specs fit several different Nikon models with different market values, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without that identifying shot.
